purpose: B = 16 training-step fix: requalify the fast backward (bitwise equal to the qualified kernel) and the TF32 GEMM option (gradient budget), race-verify the fast backward, then select among Triton forwards x backward slices/warps x {base, fast, fast+TF32} (module environment, B = 16 and 64) and TileLang forwards x {fast, fast+TF32} (TileLang environment, B = 16; FlashRNN1 prebuilt in the module environment) and time the training step against FlashRNN1
criterion: Pre-registered: B = 16 counts as fixed if, in at least one environment, the selected FlashRNN2 training step's 95% interval lower bound against FlashRNN1 is >= 1.0 for every D >= 192 and both cells; B = 64 must not regress (every shape faster before stays with lower bound >= 1.0). Otherwise the remaining gap per D is reported.

expected_minutes.basis: prebuild + requalification + race about 20 min; selection about 30 min; 40 comparisons x 5 starts about 60 min on four lanes

node_reason: One H100 node (4 H100): independent single-GPU lanes
